verdict.line: You lose if Darius lands E (Apprehend) into a full trade before your Grit bar fills W, and you win if you fight only when his E is down and let W's missing-health heal outlast his bleed.

brief.thesis: Sett's Q (Knuckle Down) hits for a percentage of max health and W (Haymaker) heals off missing health, which is the direct counter to Darius's Hemorrhage bleed over an extended trade. But Darius's E (Apprehend) hook removes your positioning choice and his level-6 R (Noxian Guillotine) is a hard execute, so the lane is won or lost on whoever lands their all-in cooldown first, not on passive CS trading.

theirWindow.what: You're getting pulled into a forced extended trade where he'll refresh Hemorrhage to 5 stacks and follow with W (Crippling Strike) to slow you in place. Don't try to walk away mid-pull — commit to your own Q/E and use your W heal rather than eating free autos while fleeing.

yourWindow.what: Step up and initiate freely. Auto to bait his W (Crippling Strike), then Q (Knuckle Down) and let your Grit bar cap so the empowered punch lands mid-trade — without E he has no way to lock you into range or escape your damage.

start.why: The HP5 and post-6-damage block from bleeding autos blunts Darius's main early poke source, Hemorrhage stacking from autos.

boots.why: Flat physical damage reduction directly cuts down Darius's auto-attack and Hemorrhage tick damage, his whole early kit.

core.why: The attack speed, damage, and slow proc let your empowered W punches land more often and lets you stick to or peel off Darius.
Crit-proc healing against a high-HP bruiser target like Darius keeps you topped up through prolonged skirmishes.
Attack speed and armor shut down Darius's ability to stack Hemorrhage quickly and blunt his post-6 all-in damage.

situational.when: he rushes lifesteal or you need grievous wounds to shut down his Q (Decimate) self-heal
he's snowballed and threatens to one-shot you with R (Noxian Guillotine) after a bad trade
their team shifts to heavy magic damage alongside Darius
the enemy team stacks hard CC beyond Darius's E slow and hook

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking adaptive force and the healing on full stacks is exactly what wins the extended trade war against a bleed-based duelist like Darius.

summoners.why: Ignite cuts Darius's Q (Decimate) self-heal and secures kills before he can stack enough Hemorrhage for a return execute; this is a lane decided by who kills first, not by sustained poke.

playing.title: Freeze pre-6
playing.detail: Hold the wave near your tower before level 6 so Darius's E (Apprehend) pull can't drag you out of turret range for a free all-in.

playing.title: Trade only when E is down
playing.detail: Watch his ability bar; only extend a fight when Apprehend is on cooldown, since without it he can't lock your position or stack bleed for free.

playing.title: Time W heal to bleed peak
playing.detail: Let your Grit bar cap and fire the empowered W (Haymaker) punch when your health is lowest from Hemorrhage ticks, since the heal scales off missing health.

playing.title: Respect the execute at 6+
playing.detail: Once he has R (Noxian Guillotine), don't linger below roughly 30% health in his range; disengage or stun with E (Facebreaker) to create distance.

playing.title: Stand at max range on his Q
playing.detail: Darius's Q (Decimate) only deals full damage and heals him on the blade edge; staying at the inner hitbox denies both his damage and his sustain.

playing.title: Use R to isolate, not just to burst
playing.detail: Sett's R (The Show Stopper) deals more damage the farther you drag him, so grab him away from his tower or team for a duel your kit wins.

playing.title: Count his stacks
playing.detail: Five stacks of Hemorrhage plus his W slow can flip a trade you were winning; disengage or commit to the kill rather than trading blow for blow at max stacks.

brief.patchCaveat: Item names, numbers, and rune shards drift patch to patch; verify current values in-client against 16.18.1 before finalizing the build, since this brief reflects the standard Sett bruiser build as of the assistant's last training update.
